title: Architecture design and review
description: Fixes structural boundaries before planning (DESIGN.md at plan:pre) and checks they survived the implementation (ARCH-REVIEW.md at verify:pre). The design half feeds the contract-drift gate, which compares each declared signature against the code; without it that gate has nothing to read. At plan:post a blocking gate checks the design's mermaid diagrams: every identifier they draw is declared in the code or introduced by the design itself.

workflow.architecture_design.description: Run the system architect before planning to produce DESIGN.md — layer placement, allowed dependencies, and the signatures that cross plan boundaries. Written at plan:pre because the planner's split of tasks across files IS the boundary decision; a design written afterwards narrates it instead of constraining it.

workflow.architecture_review.description: Run the architecture reviewer after execution to check the declared structure held: placements honoured, dependencies legal, no rejected alternative silently adopted. Distinct from gsd-verifier, which asks whether the goal was met rather than whether it was met where the design said.

workflow.architecture_diagrams_gate.description: Block planning when the phase DESIGN.md draws an identifier that exists nowhere — not declared in the code and not introduced by the design (gsd_run diagrams check). A no-op when the phase has no DESIGN.md. Deterministic: a declaration index of the project, not a model's judgement; a name it cannot resolve for certain is a warning, never a block.
